The '''City of Manetheren''' was the capital of the [[Manetheren|nation of the same name]]. 

== Description ==
A [[Waygate]] was built during the construction of Manetheren. Manetheren's [[Ogier grove]] was considered the most beautiful in the entire world, aside from perhaps the grove at [[Tar Valon]].

== History ==
During the Fall of Manetheren, the city was destroyed when the [[Aes Sedai]] queen [[Eldrene ay Ellan ay Carlan]] drew in too much of the [[One Power]] to destroy the encroaching [[Trolloc]] army.{{ref/book|1|9}}

The village of [[Emond's Field]] lies about three days' travel by horse from where the City of Manetheren once stood.{{ref/book|4|29}}
